description: This file defines a function to decorate a command object with various CLI options for a Playwright-based server, including configuration, proxy, and extension options, and handles starting the server with different modes (extension, switch, default). It also includes a utility to check for ffmpeg installation.

methods.name: decorateCommand
methods.description: Adds CLI options to a command object and sets up server start logic based on options.

methods.name: checkFfmpeg
methods.description: Checks if ffmpeg is installed and accessible.
